description: Expectimax extends minimax to games with chance, such as dice rolls or card draws. Besides the positions where a side chooses, the tree has *chance positions*, which list their outcomes with probabilities; a chance position is worth the probability-weighted mean of its outcomes' values, and the sides still take the best and the worst child. An outcome counts as a ply, and quiescence works as in the other searches, though a chance position is never quiesced. Because a mean depends on every outcome, this version searches every line to the depth, without pruning; it suits short horizons and games with few outcomes per draw. Its principal variation follows the most likely outcome at each chance position.

papers.title: The *-minimax search procedure for trees containing chance nodes

lineage.source: game-tree-search, src/expectimax.rs: "Like [`minimax()`](crate::minimax()), except that a chance position is worth the [`expectation`](Expectation::expectation) of its outcomes."
